methodology.name: HANZ 5Y retrospective replay of current Top 5 candidates
methodology.period: 5 calendar years plus up to 7 real trading-calendar buffer days; Yahoo 10y acquisition
methodology.note: Per-event technical decisions use no future bars, but Top 5 tickers are selected from the current monitor snapshot (selection/survivorship bias); this is not point-in-time OOS validation, and returns exclude execution fees and slippage. Live V43 ranking market/flow layers are not fully reconstructible historically. Not a validated BUY signal.
